purpose.zh: 让上背更灵活，打开肩膀
purpose.en: Loosen your upper back and open your shoulders.

text.zh: 臀部在膝盖正上方，胸口在两臂之间下沉
text.en: Keep your hips over your knees and sink your chest between your arms

text.zh: 双手平放椅面，手臂伸直。
text.en: Place your hands flat on the seat with straight arms.

text.zh: 腰别往下塌，停住呼吸再抬回平背。
text.en: Keep your lower back from sagging, breathe, then lift back to a flat back.

commonErrors.zh: 塌腰，而不是上背往下沉
commonErrors.en: Sagging the lower back instead of sinking the upper back.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒服的程度，疼就放松
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.

cautions.zh: 用结实、不带轮子的椅子
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.

changes: 名字「胸椎伸展 / Thoracic Extension」是术语，改「开上背 / Upper-Back Opener」
purpose 和常见错误去掉「伸展」书面词
口令按 0.8/0.6 s 缩短（胸下沉/抬起）
用户已定：改名、计时/计次、每侧/起始侧、计数单位按最终口径处理，相关待定项清除
最终口径：按真实做法定（2026-11-01）
